answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 43298 Country: India Title: Ummrah and Hajj Question: I performed Umrah 4 times whenever I use to do Umrah I use to cut hair from four sides and then do another Umrah and at 4th Umrah I shaved all my head for other 3 Umrah I just cut my hair from four sides, and after one year I want for hajj and performed Hajj Tamattu at that time when I cut my hair the Maulana of our said that dam is wajib and you can slaughter the animal or you can give food to 6 people who are poor in the boundary of Makkah, so I gave food to 6 people in the boundary of Makkah. (1) I want to know what shall I do for the 4 Umrah I have done before. (2) Is salah after tawaf wajib? Answer ID: 43298 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 121/268/N=1434) (1) If you cut less than one forth of hair in each of the first three Umrah after completing the rituals of Umrah then in the question mentioned above you wore the Ihram of second, third and forth Umrah before taking off your ihram then it is combining three Umrah hence three dams are wajib on you without any doubt. And if you committed the prohibited acts (mahzoorat) then three more dams shall be wajib on you i.e. total six dams. It should be noted that it is necessary to slaughter animal of Qurbani in the boundary of haram. It is not enough to feed poor and needy ones. (2) Yes, after each tawaf whether fardh, wajib or nafl, two rakah of tawaf salah is wajib. However, if you are free from tawaf at makrooh time then the tawaf salah should be postponed till the makrooh time is over. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
